name: Oren Vey
description: Established independent master of divination, illusion and old texts, resident at the House of Small Windows on High Isle. Private library and patronage support a pursuit of a vanished magician’s dispersed library. Has limited professional exchanges with Hesper; does not know Hesper’s private allegiance. No Crown office.

powers.name: Mental Strength
powers.effect: Once per day, mental magic resistance two grades easier; disbelieve illusions one grade easier.

score.want: Have visiting scholars entrust rare material to his care.
score.ought: Return another person’s property when asked, even if he could preserve it better.
score.driver: Fear that the most important work of his life will leave his reach.
score.stated_reason: Good scholarship needs dry rooms and responsible custodians.

status.Nimras: Established host addressing a younger professional; becomes more formal if treated as an obstacle.

tactics: Offer ordinary hospitality and useful access
Offer an exchange or ask for a copy
Withdraw and protect himself if attacked
score.blind_spot: Calls his own collecting preservation and other collectors possessive.
score.rhythm: Unhurried complete sentences, occasional scholarly digressions; answers ordinary questions readily.
score.physical: Handles papers and spectacles carefully; attire is worn comfortably rather than displayed.
score.secret: A prized fragment in his private collection is only a copy; he has not admitted the mistake.

extras.actor_notes: LOOKS: elderly man in a pale grey coat, ink at a cuff, silver-mounted spectacles. CORE: a hospitable collector who believes access to knowledge depends on someone keeping it safe. NATURE: sociable with scholars, patient with questions, pleased by an exact observation. WOUND: discoveries which were lost because he could not obtain them in time. WANTS: useful exchanges without losing custody of what he already has. PRESSURE: formality replaces warmth; he protects his own property and retreats before risking his life. KEY: register is cultivated and conversational; he does not enumerate or issue military commands.
